artists.biography:
"The Anchoress is the Welsh multi-instrumentalist, songwriter and author Catherine Anne Davies (aka Catherine AD).
The Anchoress is the stage name of Welsh musician/songwriter Catherine Anne Davies, who also records under the nom de plume Catherine A.D. A self-taught multi-instrumentalist, chanteuse, and singer/songwriter specializing in a heady blend of gothic chamber pop and dark atmospheric art rock, Davies has drawn comparisons to PJ Harvey, Nick Cave, Anna Calvi, My Brightest Diamond, and Kate Bush. She issued a series of well-received independently released EPs before switching over to the Anchoress moniker in 2014 and issuing the single "One for Sorrow.. ~ James Christopher Monger
From March to Dec 2015, Davies performed in Simple Minds' live band, contributing additional guitar and keyboards. She met Jim Kerr through The Dark Flowers collective. She has also performed live with Ed Harcourt at Glastonbury Festival, as well as Martha Wainwright.
Davies has been described by NPR's Ann Powers as "Wales's (much more explicitly feminist) answer to Lana Del Rey."

perplexity.description:
Released in 2023 via the relaunched Drowned In Sound label, Versions is a covers album by Welsh multi-instrumentalist and producer Catherine Anne Davies, known as The Anchoress. The album features re-imaginings of iconic songs by artists such as Depeche Mode, New Order, Radiohead, The Cure, Nirvana, Nico, and Halsey, among others. Musically, Versions leans into dream pop and synth-driven arrangements, showcasing Davies’ meticulous production and her ability to recast familiar tracks with a fresh, atmospheric mood. The album was produced, mixed, and engineered by Davies herself, with guest contributions from multi-instrumentalist Charlie Cawood.

Versions marks a departure from The Anchoress’s previous original albums, Confessions of a Romance Novelist (2016) and The Art of Losing (2021), both of which received critical acclaim and were named among the best albums of their respective years by outlets like The Sunday Times and PROG magazine. While Versions is a collection of covers, it is regarded as a creative and personal project, allowing Davies to focus on arrangement and production without the constraints of songwriting. The album was released to coincide with a series of autumn 2023 live dates and was made available on limited edition Eco Mix vinyl and a signed gatefold CD, reflecting its special place in her discography.
